answer_page.usage_note: satisfied在用餐语境指吃得满足。

answer_page.example_en: I don't have much of an appetite today.
answer_page.example_zh: 我今天没什么胃口。
answer_page.usage_note: appetite指食欲或胃口。

answer_page.example_en: My son is picky about vegetables.
answer_page.example_zh: 我儿子吃蔬菜很挑剔。
answer_page.usage_note: picky指挑剔，食物语境常表示挑食。

answer_page.example_en: She's a fussy eater, so we keep dinner simple.
answer_page.example_zh: 她比较挑食，所以我们把晚餐做得简单些。
answer_page.usage_note: fussy eater是挑食的人，常见于英式英语。

answer_page.example_en: We ask guests about their dietary preferences.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们会询问客人的饮食偏好。
answer_page.usage_note: dietary preference是个人选择，不应与医学过敏等同。

answer_page.example_en: I'm allergic to peanuts, so I can't eat that sauce.
answer_page.example_zh: 我对花生过敏，所以不能吃那种酱汁。
answer_page.usage_note: allergic to表示对某物过敏，需认真核实食材。

answer_page.example_en: Our vegetarian guest doesn't eat meat or fish.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们的素食客人不吃肉或鱼。
answer_page.usage_note: vegetarian可作名词或形容词；有些素食者食用蛋奶。

answer_page.example_en: Be careful not to spill a drink on the tablecloth.
answer_page.example_zh: 小心别把饮料洒在桌布上。
answer_page.usage_note: spill指液体意外洒出。

answer_page.example_en: I knocked over a glass while reaching for the bread.
answer_page.example_zh: 我伸手拿面包时碰倒了杯子。
answer_page.usage_note: knock over指碰倒物体。

answer_page.example_en: I dropped a fork, so I'll get a clean one.
answer_page.example_zh: 我把叉子掉到地上了，去拿把干净的。
answer_page.usage_note: drop在这里指不小心使餐叉掉落。

answer_page.example_en: Try not to break a plate when clearing the table.
answer_page.example_zh: 收拾餐桌时小心别打碎盘子。
answer_page.usage_note: break a plate表示将盘子打碎。

answer_page.example_en: Let the soup cool so you don't burn your tongue.
answer_page.example_zh: 让汤凉一点，别烫到舌头。
collocations: burn your tongue on hot soup
answer_page.usage_note: burn your tongue在此指食物过热造成烫伤。

answer_page.example_en: Small children can choke on food that isn't cut appropriately.
answer_page.example_zh: 食物切得不合适可能让幼儿噎住。
collocations: choking on a piece of food
answer_page.usage_note: choke on food指食物堵塞气道，是紧急情况。

answer_page.example_en: Please tell us about any food allergy before we serve dinner.
answer_page.example_zh: 上晚餐前请告诉我们是否有食物过敏。
answer_page.usage_note: food allergy与食物不耐受不同。

answer_page.example_en: He developed an allergic reaction after eating the dessert.
answer_page.example_zh: 他吃完甜点后出现了过敏反应。
answer_page.usage_note: allergic reaction指过敏症状，严重反应须紧急就医。

answer_page.example_en: I have an upset stomach, so I'll skip the spicy food.
answer_page.example_zh: 我胃不舒服，就不吃辣的了。
answer_page.usage_note: upset stomach是常见口语，指胃部不适。

answer_page.example_en: She has a food intolerance rather than a food allergy.
answer_page.example_zh: 她是食物不耐受，而不是食物过敏。
answer_page.usage_note: food intolerance与免疫性食物过敏需区分。

answer_page.example_en: Separate serving utensils help prevent cross-contamination.
answer_page.example_zh: 分开使用公用餐具能帮助防止交叉污染。
answer_page.usage_note: cross-contamination指污染物或过敏原在食物之间转移。

answer_page.example_en: Don't serve undercooked meat to the family.
answer_page.example_zh: 不要给家人端上没做熟的肉。
answer_page.usage_note: undercooked指未达到适当熟度。

answer_page.example_en: The milk has gone off, so don't use it.
answer_page.example_zh: 牛奶变质了，别用了。
answer_page.usage_note: gone off在英式英语可表示食品变质。

answer_page.example_en: The leftovers have gone bad and need to be thrown away.
answer_page.example_zh: 剩菜已经坏了，得扔掉。
answer_page.usage_note: gone bad表示食品变质。

answer_page.example_en: There's too much salt in this soup.
answer_page.example_zh: 这汤盐放得太多了。
answer_page.usage_note: too much salt指盐量过多。

answer_page.example_en: The vegetables taste bland because there's too little seasoning.
answer_page.example_zh: 蔬菜味道很淡，因为调味不足。
answer_page.usage_note: too little seasoning指调味料用得不足。

answer_page.example_en: We might run out of food if more guests arrive.
answer_page.example_zh: 如果再来客人，饭菜可能不够了。
answer_page.usage_note: run out of表示用完或不够。

answer_page.example_en: Let's make an extra portion in case someone is hungry.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们多做一份，以防有人没吃饱。
answer_page.usage_note: extra portion指额外一份。

answer_page.example_en: Portion out leftovers into smaller containers.
answer_page.example_zh: 把剩菜分装进小容器。
answer_page.usage_note: portion out表示按份分装。

answer_page.example_en: Store leftovers in sealed containers in the fridge.
answer_page.example_zh: 把剩菜放在密封容器里冷藏。
answer_page.usage_note: store leftovers是妥善保存剩菜。

answer_page.example_en: Refrigerate promptly after the meal.
answer_page.example_zh: 饭后要及时冷藏。
answer_page.usage_note: refrigerate promptly意为不要让易腐食物久放室温。

answer_page.example_en: Heat through the leftovers before serving them.
answer_page.example_zh: 剩菜上桌前要充分热透。
answer_page.usage_note: heat through强调食物内部也热透。

answer_page.example_en: Check if it's cooked using a food thermometer.
answer_page.example_zh: 用食品温度计确认食物是否熟透。
answer_page.usage_note: 肉类是否安全熟透不能只凭颜色判断。

answer_page.example_en: Cut food into small pieces for the young child.
answer_page.example_zh: 把食物切成适合幼儿的小块。
answer_page.usage_note: 切块尺寸应符合儿童咀嚼及吞咽能力。

answer_page.example_en: Watch out for bones when eating the fish.
answer_page.example_zh: 吃鱼时小心鱼刺。
answer_page.usage_note: watch out for用于提醒注意危险。

answer_page.example_en: I found a fish bone and removed it before serving.
answer_page.example_zh: 我发现一根鱼刺，上菜前把它挑了出来。
answer_page.usage_note: fish bone指鱼刺。

question_page.cue_zh: 提供另一种可吃的食物

answer_page.meaning_zh: 提供另一种可吃的食物
answer_page.example_en: If you don't like fish, I can offer an alternative.
answer_page.example_zh: 如果你不喜欢鱼，我可以提供别的选择。
answer_page.usage_note: offer an alternative表示提供可替代的菜品。

answer_page.example_en: I'll make a separate dish for our vegetarian guest.
answer_page.example_zh: 我会给素食客人另做一道菜。
answer_page.usage_note: separate dish是单独准备的一道菜。

answer_page.example_en: We need to avoid an ingredient that causes an allergy.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们需要避开会引起过敏的食材。
answer_page.usage_note: 避免某食材应考虑配料和交叉接触。

answer_page.example_en: Check the ingredients before serving the sauce to anyone with allergies.
answer_page.example_zh: 给有过敏情况的人上酱汁前先核对配料。
answer_page.usage_note: check the ingredients强调核实所用材料，过敏情况还需注意交叉接触。

answer_page.example_en: Clean a spill right away so nobody slips.
answer_page.example_zh: 马上清理洒出来的饮料，免得有人滑倒。
answer_page.usage_note: spill指意外洒漏的液体或食物。

answer_page.example_en: Please replace a broken glass with a clean one.
answer_page.example_zh: 请把破损的玻璃杯换成干净的。
collocations: replace the glass with a new one
answer_page.usage_note: broken glass指破损的玻璃杯；碎玻璃须安全清理。

answer_page.example_en: We have another guest, so set an extra place.
answer_page.example_zh: 又来了一位客人，多摆一套餐具吧。
collocations: set a place for one more guest
answer_page.usage_note: place在这里指一人份的餐具位置。

answer_page.example_en: I'll warm up a late dinner for you when you get home.
answer_page.example_zh: 你回家晚了，我会给你把晚餐热一下。
answer_page.usage_note: warm up指加热，需确保易腐剩菜储存安全。

answer_page.example_en: I saved you a plate of dinner in the fridge.
answer_page.example_zh: 我在冰箱里给你留了一盘晚饭。
collocations: save a plate of food for someone
answer_page.usage_note: save someone a plate是口语化的给某人留一份饭。

answer_page.example_en: I'll do the dishes after we finish eating.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们吃完饭后我来洗碗。
answer_page.usage_note: do the dishes是美式常见的洗餐具表达。

answer_page.example_en: Load the dishwasher after scraping off the food scraps.
answer_page.example_zh: 刮掉食物残渣后把餐具放进洗碗机。
answer_page.usage_note: dishwasher是洗碗机，也可以指洗碗工，语境决定。

answer_page.example_en: Use a little dish soap to clean the plates by hand.
answer_page.example_zh: 手洗盘子时用少量洗洁精。
answer_page.usage_note: dish soap在美式通常指手洗餐具的洗洁精，不等同于机用洗涤剂。

answer_page.example_en: Use a clean sponge to wipe the bowl.
answer_page.example_zh: 用干净海绵擦洗碗。
answer_page.usage_note: sponge指清洁海绵，要保持清洁并按需更换。

answer_page.example_en: Use a scrub brush for the stubborn dirt on the pan.
answer_page.example_zh: 锅上有顽固污垢时用刷洗刷。
answer_page.usage_note: scrub brush指刷洗用的刷子，应根据锅具表面选用。

answer_page.example_en: Put the dirty dishes in the sink.
answer_page.example_zh: 把脏餐具放进水槽。
answer_page.usage_note: sink在此指厨房水槽，不是下沉的动词义。

answer_page.example_en: Food scraps can block the drain.
answer_page.example_zh: 食物残渣可能堵塞排水口。
answer_page.usage_note: drain在这里是排水口，也可作动词。

answer_page.example_en: Use the drain stopper when filling the sink with water.
answer_page.example_zh: 往水槽里放水时用水槽塞堵住排水口。
answer_page.usage_note: drain stopper用于封住排水口。

answer_page.example_en: Place the washed plates in the dish rack.
answer_page.example_zh: 把洗好的盘子放到沥水架上。
collocations: dry dishes on a dish rack
answer_page.usage_note: dish rack用于让清洗后的餐具沥干。

answer_page.example_en: Put a dishwasher tablet in the dispenser as instructed.
answer_page.example_zh: 按说明把洗碗机洗涤块放进投放格。
answer_page.usage_note: dishwasher tablet是机用洗涤块，不是手洗餐具用洗洁精。

answer_page.example_en: The dishwasher needs rinse aid for better drying results.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗碗机需要漂洗剂来改善烘干效果。
answer_page.usage_note: rinse aid是洗碗机漂洗助剂，不是手洗洗洁精。

answer_page.example_en: Refill the dishwasher salt if the machine indicates it is low.
answer_page.example_zh: 机器提示不足时补充洗碗机软水盐。
answer_page.usage_note: dishwasher salt供适用机器的软水系统使用，不是普通餐桌盐。

answer_page.example_en: Remove the drain strainer to clear trapped food scraps.
answer_page.example_zh: 取出排水口滤网，清掉卡住的食物残渣。
answer_page.usage_note: drain strainer是拦截食物残渣的滤网。

answer_page.example_en: Rinse the plates before putting them on the drying rack.
answer_page.example_zh: 把盘子冲洗后再放到沥水架上。
answer_page.usage_note: rinse强调用清水冲洗，不一定使用洗涤剂。

answer_page.example_en: Scrub the pan gently to remove stuck-on food.
answer_page.example_zh: 轻轻刷洗锅具，去除粘住的食物。
answer_page.usage_note: scrub指用刷子或海绵摩擦清洁，注意不粘涂层。

answer_page.example_en: Rinse off the soap before drying the dishes.
answer_page.example_zh: 擦干餐具前先把洗洁精冲掉。
answer_page.usage_note: rinse off强调冲走表面的清洁剂。

answer_page.example_en: Drain the water from the sink after washing up.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗完碗后放掉水槽里的水。
answer_page.usage_note: drain作动词表示排水。

answer_page.example_en: Put dishes away once they are dry.
answer_page.example_zh: 餐具晾干后放回橱柜。
answer_page.usage_note: put away指收纳归位。

answer_page.example_en: Load the dishwasher with the dirty plates and cups.
answer_page.example_zh: 把脏盘子和杯子放进洗碗机。
answer_page.usage_note: load指装入，不表示已经开始洗涤。

answer_page.example_en: Wipe down the counter after preparing dinner.
answer_page.example_zh: 做完晚饭后把厨房操作台擦干净。
answer_page.usage_note: wipe down指把一个表面整体擦拭干净。

answer_page.example_en: Regular cleaning prevents grease buildup around the stove.
answer_page.example_zh: 定期清洁能防止灶台周围油垢堆积。
answer_page.usage_note: buildup指逐渐积聚的污垢。

answer_page.example_en: We noticed a dishwasher leak under the kitchen cabinet.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们发现厨房柜子下方有洗碗机漏水。
answer_page.usage_note: 遇到漏水应停止使用并按安全说明处理。

answer_page.example_en: White dishwasher residue was left on some glasses.
answer_page.example_zh: 一些玻璃杯上留有白色洗涤残留物。
answer_page.usage_note: residue指清洗后残留的物质，成因可能不同。

answer_page.example_en: Rinse out bottles before putting them on the rack.
answer_page.example_zh: 把瓶子内部冲洗干净后放到架子上。
answer_page.usage_note: rinse out强调冲洗容器内部。

answer_page.example_en: There are still dirty dishes in the sink.
answer_page.example_zh: 水槽里还有待洗的脏餐具。
answer_page.usage_note: dishes在洗碗场景常统称碗盘等餐具。

answer_page.example_en: Would you mind doing the washing-up tonight?
answer_page.example_zh: 今晚你介意洗碗吗？
answer_page.usage_note: do the washing-up是英式动词词组，美式多用do the dishes。

answer_page.example_en: Dishwashing takes less time when we work together.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们一起干，洗餐具就快多了。
answer_page.usage_note: dishwashing指洗餐具这一活动。

answer_page.example_en: We need more washing-up liquid for the dishes.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们还需要一些洗洁精来洗碗。
answer_page.usage_note: washing-up liquid为英式常用的手洗餐具液体洗洁精。

answer_page.example_en: Check whether the dish detergent is suitable for the dishwasher.
answer_page.example_zh: 确认这种洗碗清洁剂是否适用于洗碗机。
answer_page.usage_note: dish detergent可泛指洗碗清洁剂，机洗必须使用适配产品。

answer_page.example_en: Use a separate dishcloth for washing the dishes.
answer_page.example_zh: 用一块单独的洗碗布清洗餐具。
answer_page.usage_note: dishcloth是清洗餐具用的布。

answer_page.example_en: Wipe the stainless-steel sink with a microfiber cloth.
answer_page.example_zh: 用超细纤维抹布擦拭不锈钢水槽。
answer_page.usage_note: microfiber cloth指超细纤维抹布。

answer_page.example_en: Turn off the tap while you scrub the plates.
answer_page.example_zh: 刷洗盘子时把水龙头关上。
answer_page.usage_note: tap在英式英语中指水龙头。

answer_page.example_en: The kitchen faucet is dripping again.
answer_page.example_zh: 厨房水龙头又在滴水了。
answer_page.usage_note: faucet是美式常用的水龙头。

answer_page.example_en: Leave the washed cups on the draining board.
answer_page.example_zh: 把洗好的杯子放在水槽旁的沥水台上。
collocations: put dishes on the draining board
answer_page.usage_note: draining board通常指水槽旁沥干餐具的台面。

answer_page.example_en: Wash the utensils immediately after cooking.
answer_page.example_zh: 做完菜后及时清洗厨具。
answer_page.usage_note: utensils泛指餐具或厨房用具。

answer_page.example_en: Wash the cookware according to the manufacturer's instructions.
answer_page.example_zh: 按制造商说明清洗锅具。
answer_page.usage_note: cookware是锅、平底锅等烹饪器皿的集合称谓。

answer_page.example_en: The baking dish is soaking in warm water.
answer_page.example_zh: 烤皿正在温水里浸泡。
answer_page.usage_note: baking dish指烤皿或烤盘。

answer_page.example_en: Let the pan cool before washing it.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗锅之前先让锅冷却。
answer_page.usage_note: pan在此指锅。

answer_page.example_en: There's food stuck to the bottom of the pot.
answer_page.example_zh: 深锅底部粘着食物。
answer_page.usage_note: pot通常是深锅。

answer_page.example_en: Wash the lid along with the pot.
answer_page.example_zh: 把锅盖和锅一起洗。
answer_page.usage_note: lid指盖子。

answer_page.example_en: Wipe the countertop after preparing lunch.
answer_page.example_zh: 准备午饭后擦拭操作台。
answer_page.usage_note: countertop指操作台面。

answer_page.example_en: Clean the stovetop once it has cooled.
answer_page.example_zh: 等灶台冷却后再清洁。
answer_page.usage_note: stovetop是炉灶上表面。

answer_page.example_en: Grease has splashed onto the backsplash.
answer_page.example_zh: 油脂溅到了防溅板。
answer_page.usage_note: backsplash是水槽或灶台后的防溅墙面。

answer_page.example_en: Brush the crumbs off the table.
answer_page.example_zh: 把桌上的食物碎屑拂掉。
answer_page.usage_note: crumbs通常指面包等的小碎屑。

answer_page.example_en: Scrape the food scraps into the bin.
answer_page.example_zh: 把食物残渣刮进垃圾桶。
answer_page.usage_note: food scraps是零碎剩余食物。

answer_page.example_en: Sort food waste according to local rules.
answer_page.example_zh: 按照当地规定分类厨余垃圾。
answer_page.usage_note: food waste表示厨余垃圾。

answer_page.example_en: Never put your hand inside a garbage disposal.
answer_page.example_zh: 绝不要把手伸进垃圾处理器。
answer_page.usage_note: garbage disposal在美式指水槽垃圾处理器。

answer_page.example_en: The bin is full, so I'll empty it.
answer_page.example_zh: 垃圾桶满了，我去清空。
answer_page.usage_note: bin是英式常用垃圾桶说法。

answer_page.example_en: Put the used towels in the trash can.
answer_page.example_zh: 把用过的纸巾扔进垃圾桶。
answer_page.usage_note: trash can是美式常见说法。

answer_page.example_en: The clean jars go in the recycling bin.
answer_page.example_zh: 干净的玻璃罐放进可回收物桶。
collocations: put bottles in the recycling bin
answer_page.usage_note: 分类要求依当地规定。

answer_page.example_en: The plate still has sauce on it.
answer_page.example_zh: 盘子上还有酱汁。
answer_page.usage_note: plate在此是盘子。

answer_page.example_en: Rinse the bowl before putting it away.
answer_page.example_zh: 收起碗前先冲洗。
answer_page.usage_note: bowl表示碗。

answer_page.example_en: There's a coffee stain inside the mug.
answer_page.example_zh: 马克杯里有咖啡渍。
answer_page.usage_note: mug通常是带柄的大杯子。

answer_page.example_en: Wash the glass carefully so it doesn't slip.
answer_page.example_zh: 小心洗玻璃杯以免滑落。
answer_page.usage_note: glass指玻璃饮水杯。

answer_page.example_en: Rinse the cup thoroughly after washing it.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗完杯子后彻底冲净。
answer_page.usage_note: cup为杯子的通称。

answer_page.example_en: Put the fork in the cutlery tray.
answer_page.example_zh: 把叉子放进餐具格。
answer_page.usage_note: fork指餐叉。

answer_page.example_en: Place the knife carefully on the rack.
answer_page.example_zh: 小心把餐刀放在架上。
answer_page.usage_note: knife复数knives，注意刀刃。

answer_page.example_en: The spoon is greasy, so wash it again.
answer_page.example_zh: 勺子油腻，再洗一次。
answer_page.usage_note: spoon是勺子。

answer_page.example_en: Wash the chopsticks and let them dry.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗净筷子并晾干。
answer_page.usage_note: chopsticks常用复数。

answer_page.example_en: The ladle needs washing after serving soup.
answer_page.example_zh: 盛汤后的汤勺需要清洗。
answer_page.usage_note: ladle指长柄汤勺。

answer_page.example_en: Wash the spatula after cooking.
answer_page.example_zh: 做完菜后清洗锅铲。
answer_page.usage_note: spatula可指锅铲或刮刀。

answer_page.example_en: Rinse the colander after draining pasta.
answer_page.example_zh: 沥干意面后冲洗漏盆。
answer_page.usage_note: colander指滤水盆。

answer_page.example_en: Food particles are caught in the strainer.
answer_page.example_zh: 食物碎渣卡在滤网里。
answer_page.usage_note: strainer指过滤网。

answer_page.example_en: Wash the cutting board after preparing raw meat.
answer_page.example_zh: 处理生肉后清洗砧板。
answer_page.usage_note: 需避免生熟食材交叉污染。

answer_page.example_en: Dry the wooden board after washing.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗完木砧板后晾干。
answer_page.usage_note: wooden board在此指木砧板。

answer_page.example_en: Check that the plastic container is dishwasher-safe.
answer_page.example_zh: 确认塑料盒可用洗碗机清洗。
answer_page.usage_note: 耐机洗须依据产品标记。

answer_page.example_en: Let the food storage container dry before sealing it.
answer_page.example_zh: 食物收纳盒干燥后再密封。
answer_page.usage_note: food storage container是食物储存盒。

answer_page.example_en: Use a brush to clean the inside of the bottle.
answer_page.example_zh: 用刷子清洗瓶子内部。
answer_page.usage_note: bottle指瓶子。

answer_page.example_en: I wash my water bottle every evening.
answer_page.example_zh: 我每天晚上清洗水瓶。
answer_page.usage_note: water bottle指盛饮用水的瓶子。

answer_page.example_en: Check the thermos instructions before machine-washing.
answer_page.example_zh: 机洗保温瓶前先看使用说明。
answer_page.usage_note: thermos通常指保温瓶。

answer_page.example_en: Wear rubber gloves when washing greasy pans.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗油腻锅具时戴橡胶手套。
answer_page.usage_note: rubber gloves有助于保护双手。

answer_page.example_en: Use a non-scratch scouring pad for this pan.
answer_page.example_zh: 这口锅要用不伤表面的百洁布。
answer_page.usage_note: scouring pad是擦洗垫。

answer_page.example_en: Don't use steel wool on a nonstick coating.
answer_page.example_zh: 别用钢丝球擦不粘涂层。
answer_page.usage_note: steel wool具有较强磨蚀性。

answer_page.example_en: A bottle brush can reach the bottom of the bottle.
answer_page.example_zh: 刷瓶刷可以刷到瓶底。
answer_page.usage_note: bottle brush是清洁瓶内的刷子。

answer_page.example_en: Wipe up the water with a paper towel.
answer_page.example_zh: 用厨房纸巾擦掉洒出的水。
answer_page.usage_note: paper towel是吸水纸巾。

answer_page.example_en: Use a surface cleaner suitable for the countertop.
answer_page.example_zh: 使用适合台面的表面清洁剂。
answer_page.usage_note: 注意清洁剂适用材质。

answer_page.example_en: Use the disinfectant according to the label.
answer_page.example_zh: 按照标签说明使用消毒剂。
answer_page.usage_note: 不得随意混合不同消毒清洁剂。

answer_page.example_en: A degreaser helps remove stubborn kitchen grease.
answer_page.example_zh: 去油污剂有助于清除顽固油垢。
answer_page.usage_note: degreaser用于去除油脂。

answer_page.example_en: Use a plastic scraper to lift off the dried food.
answer_page.example_zh: 用塑料刮刀刮掉干结食物。
answer_page.usage_note: scraper是刮除污垢的工具。

answer_page.example_en: Replace the bin liner when you empty the rubbish.
answer_page.example_zh: 倒垃圾后换一个垃圾袋。
answer_page.usage_note: bin liner是垃圾桶内衬袋。

answer_page.example_en: Put suitable vegetable scraps in the compost bin.
answer_page.example_zh: 把适合堆肥的蔬菜残渣放进堆肥桶。
answer_page.usage_note: 遵循当地堆肥分类规则。

answer_page.example_en: Separate the recycling from ordinary rubbish.
answer_page.example_zh: 把可回收物与普通垃圾分开。
answer_page.usage_note: recycling在此指可回收物。

answer_page.example_en: Clear the dishes after everyone has eaten.
answer_page.example_zh: 大家吃完后撤走餐具。
answer_page.usage_note: clear the dishes是把餐具从桌上收走。

answer_page.example_en: Scrape food off plates before machine-washing.
answer_page.example_zh: 机洗前先把盘中残渣刮掉。
answer_page.usage_note: scrape off表示刮去残渣。

answer_page.example_en: Stack the dishes carefully by the sink.
answer_page.example_zh: 把碗碟小心叠放在水槽旁。
answer_page.usage_note: stack是堆叠。

answer_page.example_en: Soak a pan in warm water to loosen food.
answer_page.example_zh: 用温水浸泡锅具使粘住的食物软化。
answer_page.usage_note: soak表示浸泡。

answer_page.example_en: Fill the sink with water before soaking the pans.
answer_page.example_zh: 浸泡锅具前往水槽里放水。
answer_page.usage_note: fill强调把容器装到需要的水位。

answer_page.example_en: Turn on the tap to rinse the plates.
answer_page.example_zh: 打开水龙头冲洗盘子。
answer_page.usage_note: tap是英式水龙头，美式常说faucet。

answer_page.example_en: Turn off the tap while you scrub the dishes.
answer_page.example_zh: 刷洗餐具时关掉水龙头。
answer_page.usage_note: turn off表示关闭水流。

answer_page.example_en: Squirt on dish soap and scrub the greasy pan.
answer_page.example_zh: 挤一点洗洁精后刷洗油锅。
collocations: squirt dish soap onto a sponge
answer_page.usage_note: squirt指从瓶中挤出少量液体。

answer_page.example_en: Lather up a sponge with a little warm water.
answer_page.example_zh: 用少量温水让海绵起泡。
answer_page.usage_note: lather up指形成泡沫。

answer_page.example_en: Wipe the plate with a soapy sponge.
answer_page.example_zh: 用带洗洁精泡沫的海绵擦洗盘子。
answer_page.usage_note: wipe指擦拭表面。

answer_page.example_en: Wash the glasses separately so they don't break.
answer_page.example_zh: 玻璃杯单独清洗，以免打碎。
answer_page.usage_note: glasses在此指多个饮水玻璃杯。

answer_page.example_en: Leave dishes to dry on the rack after rinsing.
answer_page.example_zh: 冲净后把餐具放在架上晾干。
collocations: leave the dishes to dry overnight
answer_page.usage_note: leave to dry强调放着自然干燥。

answer_page.example_en: Air-dry the dishes instead of using a towel.
answer_page.example_zh: 让餐具自然晾干，不用布擦。
answer_page.usage_note: air-dry指在空气中自然变干。

answer_page.example_en: Dry dishes with a towel before putting them away.
answer_page.example_zh: 收纳餐具前用布把它们擦干。
collocations: dry clean dishes with a towel
answer_page.usage_note: towel要保持清洁并注意玻璃器皿。

answer_page.example_en: Put dishes on the rack with enough space between them.
answer_page.example_zh: 把餐具分开放在沥水架上。
collocations: put plates on the drying rack
answer_page.usage_note: rack在此为餐具沥水架。

question_page.cue_zh: 从洗碗机取出洗净餐具

answer_page.meaning_zh: 从洗碗机取出洗净餐具
answer_page.example_en: Unload the dishwasher once the dishes have cooled.
answer_page.example_zh: 餐具冷却后把它们从洗碗机取出。
answer_page.usage_note: unload是取出洗好的餐具，与load相反。

answer_page.example_en: Start the dishwasher after checking the detergent.
answer_page.example_zh: 检查洗涤剂后启动洗碗机。
answer_page.usage_note: start是启动机器。

answer_page.example_en: Select a wash cycle suitable for the dishes.
answer_page.example_zh: 选择适合这些餐具的洗涤程序。
answer_page.usage_note: wash cycle是洗碗机的洗涤程序。

answer_page.example_en: Run a dishwasher cycle after dinner.
answer_page.example_zh: 晚饭后运行一轮洗碗机。
answer_page.usage_note: run a cycle指运行一次程序。

answer_page.example_en: Open the dishwasher door carefully after the cycle.
answer_page.example_zh: 程序结束后小心打开洗碗机门。
collocations: open the door after a cycle
answer_page.usage_note: 开门时可能有热蒸汽。

answer_page.example_en: Empty the filter according to the dishwasher manual.
answer_page.example_zh: 按洗碗机说明清空滤网。
answer_page.usage_note: filter指过滤食物残渣的部件。

answer_page.example_en: Clean the spray arms if the jets are blocked.
answer_page.example_zh: 喷孔堵住时清洁洗碗机喷淋臂。
answer_page.usage_note: spray arms通过喷水清洗餐具。

answer_page.example_en: Clean the stovetop once it has cooled down.
answer_page.example_zh: 灶台冷却后再清洁。
answer_page.usage_note: stovetop指灶面。

answer_page.example_en: Wipe up spills before they make the floor slippery.
answer_page.example_zh: 洒出的液体要及时擦掉，免得地面打滑。
answer_page.usage_note: wipe up指擦净洒漏的液体。

answer_page.example_en: Sweep up crumbs from under the table.
answer_page.example_zh: 把桌子下面的碎屑扫起来。
answer_page.usage_note: sweep up指扫拢并清除。

answer_page.example_en: Mop the kitchen floor after sweeping it.
answer_page.example_zh: 扫完后再拖厨房地板。
answer_page.usage_note: mop作动词指用拖把拖地。

answer_page.example_en: Take out the trash before the bin starts smelling.
answer_page.example_zh: 垃圾桶发臭前把垃圾拿出去倒掉。
answer_page.usage_note: trash是美式垃圾说法。

answer_page.example_en: Replace the bin liner with a fresh bag.
answer_page.example_zh: 换一个新的垃圾袋。
answer_page.usage_note: bin liner为垃圾桶内衬袋。

answer_page.example_en: Sort the recycling before taking it outside.
answer_page.example_zh: 把可回收物分好类再拿出去。
answer_page.usage_note: 具体可回收类别依当地规定。

answer_page.example_en: Wash out containers before putting them in the recycling bin.
answer_page.example_zh: 把容器冲洗干净后再放入可回收物桶。
answer_page.usage_note: wash out强调冲洗容器内部。

question_page.english_expression: put food scraps in the bin

answer_page.example_en: Put food scraps in the bin rather than down the drain.
answer_page.example_zh: 把食物残渣倒进垃圾桶，别倒入排水口。
collocations: put food scraps in the bin
put scraps in the food-waste bin
answer_page.usage_note: 食物垃圾分类应遵照当地规则。

answer_page.example_en: Clean the sink after doing the dishes.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗完碗后清洁水槽。
answer_page.usage_note: sink是厨房水槽。

answer_page.example_en: Wipe the faucet to remove water spots.
answer_page.example_zh: 擦水龙头，去掉水渍。
answer_page.usage_note: faucet是美式水龙头。

answer_page.example_en: Remove grease from the pan with dish soap.
answer_page.example_zh: 用洗洁精清除锅具上的油污。
answer_page.usage_note: grease在此是油脂油污。

answer_page.example_en: Sanitize the cutting board after cleaning it.
answer_page.example_zh: 清洗砧板后再按适用方法消毒。
answer_page.usage_note: sanitize区别于简单擦洗，需使用适当安全方法。

answer_page.example_en: Disinfect the counter according to the product label.
answer_page.example_zh: 按产品标签说明给操作台消毒。
answer_page.usage_note: 不同消毒剂不能任意混用。

answer_page.example_en: Put away the cleaning supplies once you're finished.
answer_page.example_zh: 打扫完后把清洁用品收好。
answer_page.usage_note: 清洁用品应按标签安全存放。

answer_page.example_en: The plates are dirty and need washing.
answer_page.example_zh: 盘子脏了，需要清洗。
answer_page.usage_note: dirty在此描述不洁净。

answer_page.example_en: The glasses are clean and ready to use.
answer_page.example_zh: 杯子洗干净了，可以用了。
answer_page.usage_note: clean作形容词表示干净。

answer_page.example_en: The pan is greasy after frying bacon.
answer_page.example_zh: 煎完培根后平底锅油腻腻的。
answer_page.usage_note: greasy指沾满油脂。

answer_page.example_en: The countertop feels sticky after the juice spill.
answer_page.example_zh: 果汁洒过后，操作台摸起来黏糊糊的。
answer_page.usage_note: sticky指有黏性。

answer_page.example_en: The baking dish is crusty with dried sauce.
answer_page.example_zh: 烤皿上沾满干硬的酱汁残渣。
answer_page.usage_note: crusty在此指沾着硬壳状残渣。

answer_page.example_en: Soak the burnt-on food before scrubbing.
answer_page.example_zh: 先浸泡烧结的食物残渣再刷洗。
answer_page.usage_note: burnt-on形容烧焦并牢固粘附的污垢。

answer_page.example_en: The baking dish has baked-on sauce around the edges.
answer_page.example_zh: 烤皿边缘粘着烘烤后结牢的酱汁。
answer_page.usage_note: baked-on指经烘烤粘牢。

answer_page.example_en: Rinse the soapy plate with clean water.
answer_page.example_zh: 用清水冲洗沾满肥皂泡的盘子。
answer_page.usage_note: soapy指带有肥皂或洗洁精泡沫。

answer_page.example_en: The sink is sudsy after washing several pans.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗了几口锅后水槽里满是泡沫。
answer_page.usage_note: sudsy表示泡沫很多。

answer_page.example_en: Put the rinsed cups on the drying rack.
answer_page.example_zh: 把冲洗过的杯子放在沥水架上。
answer_page.usage_note: rinsed表示已经用水冲洗。

answer_page.example_en: Check that the dishes are dry before storing them.
answer_page.example_zh: 收纳餐具前检查是否已干。
answer_page.usage_note: dry指没有水分。

answer_page.example_en: The towel is wet, so use a fresh one.
answer_page.example_zh: 这条擦碗巾湿了，换一条干净的。
answer_page.usage_note: wet表示明显沾水。

answer_page.example_en: The dishcloth is still damp from washing up.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗碗布还潮湿。
answer_page.usage_note: damp指有些潮湿而非完全湿透。

answer_page.example_en: The kitchen sink is spotless after cleaning.
answer_page.example_zh: 厨房水槽清洁后一尘不染。
answer_page.usage_note: spotless指非常干净，没有可见污点。

answer_page.example_en: The mirror-like surface looks streaky after wiping.
answer_page.example_zh: 擦拭后镜面般的表面留下条纹。
answer_page.usage_note: streaky指留有擦拭条痕。

answer_page.example_en: The glasses look cloudy even after washing.
answer_page.example_zh: 玻璃杯洗过后仍显得发雾。
answer_page.usage_note: cloudy在此指玻璃不透亮。

answer_page.example_en: The clean glasses are sparkling in the sunlight.
answer_page.example_zh: 干净的玻璃杯在阳光下闪闪发亮。
answer_page.usage_note: sparkling在此形容玻璃杯洁净透亮。

answer_page.example_en: The teacup is stained from years of use.
answer_page.example_zh: 这只茶杯因多年使用留下污渍。
answer_page.usage_note: stained表示表面有污渍，不等于已损坏。

answer_page.example_en: The frying pan is scratched, so use a gentler sponge.
answer_page.example_zh: 平底锅有划痕了，换用柔软点的海绵吧。
answer_page.usage_note: scratched表示表面有划痕。

answer_page.example_en: Don't use that chipped bowl; the edge is sharp.
answer_page.example_zh: 别用那只缺口碗，边缘很锋利。
answer_page.usage_note: chipped指边缘有缺口，与cracked裂纹不同。

answer_page.example_en: The glass is cracked and should be replaced.
answer_page.example_zh: 玻璃杯有裂纹，应该换掉。
answer_page.usage_note: cracked强调产生裂纹，未必已经碎开。

answer_page.example_en: The leaking dishwasher has left water on the floor.
answer_page.example_zh: 漏水的洗碗机把地板弄湿了。
answer_page.usage_note: leaking形容液体从不应漏出的地方漏出。

answer_page.example_en: The sink is clogged with food scraps.
answer_page.example_zh: 水槽被食物残渣堵住了。
answer_page.usage_note: clogged表示堵塞，通常导致排水不畅。

answer_page.example_en: The sink is overflowing because the tap was left on.
answer_page.example_zh: 水龙头没关，水槽的水正溢出来。
answer_page.usage_note: overflowing表示水等超过容器边缘而溢出。

answer_page.example_en: The dishwasher is full, so let's run it tonight.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗碗机装满了，我们今晚开机吧。
answer_page.usage_note: full在此指装满，不是吃饱。

answer_page.example_en: The sink is empty now that we've finished washing up.
answer_page.example_zh: 洗完碗后水槽空了。
answer_page.usage_note: empty是空的，也可作动词清空。

answer_page.example_en: Be careful—the pan is still hot.
answer_page.example_zh: 小心，锅还很烫。
answer_page.usage_note: hot在此指温度高，可能烫伤。

answer_page.example_en: The wet kitchen floor is slippery.
answer_page.example_zh: 厨房地板湿了，很滑。
answer_page.usage_note: slippery表示容易滑倒。

answer_page.example_en: Wrap fragile glassware carefully before moving it.
answer_page.example_zh: 搬运前把易碎玻璃器皿小心包好。
answer_page.usage_note: fragile指容易破损。

answer_page.example_en: Check the label to see whether this bowl is dishwasher-safe.
answer_page.example_zh: 看看标签，确认这只碗是否可放洗碗机。
answer_page.usage_note: dishwasher-safe表示适合机洗，应以产品说明为准。

answer_page.example_en: The wooden spoon says hand-wash only on its label.
answer_page.example_zh: 这把木勺的标签注明只能手洗。
answer_page.usage_note: hand-wash only是保养标示，不表示只用清水洗。

answer_page.example_en: Use a soft sponge on the nonstick pan.
answer_page.example_zh: 不粘锅要用柔软的海绵清洁。
answer_page.usage_note: nonstick指具有不粘涂层。

answer_page.example_en: Handle the delicate glasses with care.
answer_page.example_zh: 轻拿轻放这些容易损坏的玻璃杯。
answer_page.usage_note: delicate在这里指材质精细、易损。

answer_page.example_en: Choose a food-safe container for the leftovers.
answer_page.example_zh: 给剩菜选一个适合接触食品的容器。
answer_page.usage_note: food-safe指适合与食品接触，不等于可以微波加热。

answer_page.example_en: The cutting board has been sanitized and is ready to use.
answer_page.example_zh: 砧板已经按要求消毒，可以使用了。
answer_page.usage_note: sanitized表示经过适当的卫生处理，不能仅凭外观判断。

answer_page.example_en: Use the disinfected counter to prepare the next batch of food.
answer_page.example_zh: 在消毒后的操作台上准备下一批食材。
answer_page.usage_note: disinfected强调已实施消毒处理。

answer_page.example_en: The clean storage container is completely odor-free.
answer_page.example_zh: 干净的储物盒完全没有异味。
answer_page.usage_note: odor-free表示没有异味；英式常写odour-free。

answer_page.example_en: The dishcloth smells musty because it stayed damp.
answer_page.example_zh: 抹布一直潮湿，闻起来有霉味。
answer_page.usage_note: musty指潮湿环境带来的霉闷气味。

answer_page.example_en: A blocked drain can make the sink overflow.
answer_page.example_zh: 排水管堵住可能导致水槽溢水。
answer_page.usage_note: blocked drain指排水管道受阻。

answer_page.example_en: The clogged sink needs attention before we wash more dishes.
answer_page.example_zh: 水槽堵了，得先处理再洗更多餐具。
answer_page.usage_note: clogged sink强调水槽排水不畅。

answer_page.example_en: We have a slow drain, so the water takes ages to disappear.
answer_page.example_zh: 排水很慢，水要很久才能流走。
answer_page.usage_note: slow drain指排水缓慢。

answer_page.example_en: A leaky faucet is wasting water in the kitchen.
answer_page.example_zh: 厨房漏水的水龙头正在浪费水。
answer_page.usage_note: leaky faucet是美式水龙头漏水表达。

answer_page.example_en: The dripping tap kept me awake last night.
answer_page.example_zh: 昨晚水龙头滴个不停，害我睡不着。
answer_page.usage_note: dripping tap为英式常见说法。

answer_page.example_en: The water overflow damaged the cabinet below the sink.
answer_page.example_zh: 溢出的水把水槽下方的柜子弄坏了。
answer_page.usage_note: water overflow指水溢出所造成的情况。

answer_page.example_en: Food buildup in the drain can cause unpleasant smells.
answer_page.example_zh: 排水口积聚食物残渣会引起异味。
answer_page.usage_note: buildup指逐渐积聚。

answer_page.example_en: Keep your hands away from the broken glass.
answer_page.example_zh: 手不要碰碎玻璃。
answer_page.usage_note: broken glass可指碎玻璃或破损玻璃器皿。

answer_page.example_en: There's a sharp shard of glass near the bin.
answer_page.example_zh: 垃圾桶旁有一块锋利的玻璃碎片。
answer_page.usage_note: shard通常指玻璃或陶瓷等硬质碎片。

answer_page.example_en: The chipped plate has a rough edge.
answer_page.example_zh: 这只缺口盘子的边缘很粗糙。
answer_page.usage_note: chipped指盘沿缺损，可能划伤。

answer_page.example_en: Avoid abrasive pads on a scratched coating.
answer_page.example_zh: 涂层已经刮花，就不要用粗糙的清洁垫。
answer_page.usage_note: coating是表面涂层，scratched表示有划痕。

answer_page.example_en: We should replace this damaged nonstick pan.
answer_page.example_zh: 这口涂层损坏的不粘锅该换了。
answer_page.usage_note: 不粘涂层损坏时应依制造商建议处理。

answer_page.example_en: The glasses have hard-water marks after drying.
answer_page.example_zh: 玻璃杯晾干后留下硬水水渍。
answer_page.usage_note: hard water指矿物质含量较高的水。

answer_page.example_en: Limescale has built up around the faucet.
answer_page.example_zh: 水龙头周围积了水垢。
answer_page.usage_note: limescale通常由水中矿物质沉积形成。

answer_page.example_en: Wipe the water spots off the stainless-steel sink.
answer_page.example_zh: 把不锈钢水槽上的水滴痕擦掉。
answer_page.usage_note: water spots指水滴干后留下的痕迹。

answer_page.example_en: There's an unpleasant odor coming from the sink.
answer_page.example_zh: 水槽里传出难闻的气味。
answer_page.usage_note: odor是美式拼法，英式常写odour。

answer_page.example_en: We noticed mold around the sink where the seal stays damp.
answer_page.example_zh: 水槽周围密封处经常潮湿，我们发现了霉菌。
answer_page.usage_note: mold是美式拼法，清理霉菌需注意防护。

answer_page.example_en: Clean the drain strainer before the food scraps pile up.
answer_page.example_zh: 趁残渣没积起来先清理排水口滤网。
answer_page.usage_note: drain strainer用于拦截残渣。

answer_page.example_en: We need to unblock the drain so the sink can empty properly.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们得疏通排水管，让水槽正常排水。
answer_page.usage_note: unblock表示移除堵塞物，注意遵守设备安全说明。

answer_page.example_en: Use a plunger only if it's suitable for this drain.
answer_page.example_zh: 只有适合这种排水口时才用皮搋子疏通。
answer_page.usage_note: plunger是通过压力疏通管道的工具。

question_page.english_expression: avoid pouring grease down the sink

answer_page.example_en: Avoid pouring grease down the sink; it can clog the pipes.
answer_page.example_zh: 不要把油脂倒进水槽，可能堵塞管道。
collocations: avoid pouring grease down the sink
answer_page.usage_note: 动词pouring在avoid之后用动名词形式。

answer_page.example_en: Clean the dishwasher filter according to the manual.
answer_page.example_zh: 按说明书清洁洗碗机滤网。
answer_page.usage_note: filter清洁频率应以机型说明为准。

answer_page.example_en: Refill rinse aid when the indicator comes on.
answer_page.example_zh: 漂洗剂指示灯亮时补充漂洗剂。
answer_page.usage_note: rinse aid是机用漂洗剂。

answer_page.example_en: Run a cleaning cycle to maintain the dishwasher.
answer_page.example_zh: 运行清洁程序保养洗碗机。
answer_page.usage_note: cleaning cycle是专用清洁程序，区别于普通洗碗程序。

answer_page.example_en: Replace a worn sponge rather than continuing to use it.
answer_page.example_zh: 海绵磨损了就换掉，不要继续用。
answer_page.usage_note: worn表示因使用而磨损。

answer_page.example_en: Follow the product instructions if you sanitize a sponge.
answer_page.example_zh: 给海绵消毒时，按产品说明操作。
answer_page.usage_note: sanitize指卫生消毒处理；严重磨损或发霉海绵应更换。

answer_page.example_en: Use a soft cloth to remove water marks from the faucet.
answer_page.example_zh: 用软布擦掉水龙头上的水渍。
answer_page.usage_note: water marks为水留下的痕迹。

answer_page.example_en: Wear sturdy gloves when you clean up broken glass.
answer_page.example_zh: 清理碎玻璃时戴结实的手套。
answer_page.usage_note: 清理碎玻璃应避免徒手拾取细小碎片。

answer_page.example_en: Wear protective gloves when handling sharp waste.
answer_page.example_zh: 处理尖锐垃圾时戴防护手套。
answer_page.usage_note: protective gloves需匹配具体危险类型。

answer_page.example_en: Separate sharp waste from ordinary rubbish to prevent injuries.
answer_page.example_zh: 把尖锐垃圾与普通垃圾分开，防止受伤。
answer_page.usage_note: sharp waste包括碎玻璃等，处置方式应遵循当地规定。

answer_page.example_en: Dry the counter after wiping it down.
answer_page.example_zh: 擦拭完操作台后把它擦干。
collocations: dry the counter with a cloth
answer_page.usage_note: dry作动词表示擦去水分。

answer_page.example_en: Use a towel under the leaking pipe to help prevent water damage.
answer_page.example_zh: 在漏水管道下面放块毛巾，帮助防止水损坏物品。
answer_page.usage_note: prevent water damage指避免水侵蚀家具或设备，漏水仍需修复。

answer_page.example_en: Open a window to ventilate the kitchen after cooking.
answer_page.example_zh: 做完饭打开窗户给厨房通风。
answer_page.usage_note: ventilate指让空气流通。

answer_page.example_en: I need to rest after a long day.
answer_page.example_zh: 忙了一整天，我得休息一下。
answer_page.usage_note: rest强调停止活动以恢复体力。

answer_page.example_en: I like to relax on the sofa after dinner.
answer_page.example_zh: 晚饭后我喜欢在沙发上放松。
answer_page.usage_note: relax是放松身心，可作不及物动词。

answer_page.example_en: A warm bath helps me unwind after work.
answer_page.example_zh: 下班后泡个热水澡能帮我放松心情。
answer_page.usage_note: unwind常指忙碌或紧张之后逐渐放松。

answer_page.example_en: Let's take a break and have some tea.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们歇一会儿，喝点茶吧。
answer_page.usage_note: take a break指暂停活动短暂休息。

answer_page.example_en: The kids need some quiet time before bed.
answer_page.example_zh: 孩子们睡前需要一段安静时间。
answer_page.usage_note: quiet time是减少活动与干扰的安静时段。

answer_page.example_en: I'm going to take a quick nap this afternoon.
answer_page.example_zh: 今天下午我打算小睡一会儿。
answer_page.usage_note: nap为短时间睡眠。

answer_page.example_en: We decided to stay home and watch a movie.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们决定待在家里看电影。
answer_page.usage_note: stay home表示留在家，不外出。

answer_page.example_en: I fell asleep on the sofa during the movie.
answer_page.example_zh: 看电影时我在沙发上睡着了。
answer_page.usage_note: sofa为沙发，美式口语还常说couch。

answer_page.example_en: Come sit on the couch and tell me about your day.
answer_page.example_zh: 过来坐在沙发上，说说你今天怎么样。
answer_page.usage_note: couch在美式口语中常指沙发。

answer_page.example_en: I like to read a book before going to sleep.
answer_page.example_zh: 我喜欢睡前读书。
answer_page.usage_note: read a book指阅读一本书，read过去式发音不同。

answer_page.example_en: Let's listen to music while we relax.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们边休息边听音乐吧。
answer_page.usage_note: listen to后接所听内容，不能省去to。

answer_page.example_en: This chair is surprisingly comfortable.
answer_page.example_zh: 这把椅子坐起来出乎意料地舒服。
answer_page.usage_note: comfortable形容人或物让人感到舒服。

answer_page.example_en: The living room feels cozy with the lamps on.
answer_page.example_zh: 开着台灯时，客厅显得很温馨。
answer_page.usage_note: cozy偏美式拼写，英式常写cosy。

answer_page.example_en: It's quiet here in the morning.
answer_page.example_zh: 这里早晨很安静。
answer_page.usage_note: quiet表示噪声少或安静。

answer_page.example_en: I try to wind down before bed by turning off my phone.
answer_page.example_zh: 我会在睡前关掉手机，让自己慢慢放松。
collocations: wind down after a busy day
answer_page.usage_note: wind down指逐渐从忙碌状态转向放松。

answer_page.example_en: I find relaxation in a quiet evening at home.
answer_page.example_zh: 安静地在家过一晚能让我放松。
answer_page.usage_note: relaxation是名词，表示放松状态或过程。

answer_page.example_en: Take it easy this weekend; you've worked hard.
answer_page.example_zh: 这个周末放轻松点，你已经很辛苦了。
collocations: take it easy for a few days
answer_page.usage_note: take it easy是随意、友好的劝休息表达。

answer_page.example_en: I use my downtime to catch up on reading.
answer_page.example_zh: 我利用空闲休息时间补补阅读。
answer_page.usage_note: downtime指不忙碌、能休息的时间。

answer_page.example_en: I like cooking in my free time.
answer_page.example_zh: 我空闲时喜欢做饭。
answer_page.usage_note: free time指没有工作等安排的时间。

answer_page.example_en: Reading is how I spend my leisure time.
answer_page.example_zh: 阅读是我度过休闲时间的方式。
answer_page.usage_note: leisure time偏书面，强调闲暇。

answer_page.example_en: I had a quick catnap on the sofa.
answer_page.example_zh: 我在沙发上打了个盹。
answer_page.usage_note: catnap是非正式说法，指很短的小睡。

answer_page.example_en: I started to doze while reading.
answer_page.example_zh: 读书时我开始打瞌睡。
answer_page.usage_note: doze指昏昏欲睡或短暂入睡。

answer_page.example_en: We lounged on the couch all Sunday afternoon.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们整个周日下午都懒洋洋地躺在沙发上。
answer_page.usage_note: lounge作动词指悠闲地坐着或躺着。

answer_page.example_en: You should lie down for a few minutes.
answer_page.example_zh: 你应该躺几分钟休息一下。
answer_page.usage_note: lie down表示躺下，过去式是lay。

answer_page.example_en: I stretched out on the sofa with a blanket.
answer_page.example_zh: 我盖着毯子在沙发上舒展身体躺着。
answer_page.usage_note: stretch out在此强调伸展四肢躺下。

answer_page.example_en: Let's take a breather before cleaning up.
answer_page.example_zh: 收拾之前先歇口气吧。
answer_page.usage_note: take a breather是口语，指短暂休息。

answer_page.example_en: I need the weekend to recharge.
answer_page.example_zh: 我需要周末恢复精力。
answer_page.usage_note: recharge可比喻恢复体力或精神。

answer_page.example_en: It took me a day to recover from the long trip.
answer_page.example_zh: 长途旅行后我花了一天恢复体力。
answer_page.usage_note: recover from后接导致疲劳或需要恢复的事情。

answer_page.example_en: Rest up before tomorrow's early start.
answer_page.example_zh: 明天要早起，今晚好好休息。
answer_page.usage_note: rest up强调充分休息以恢复精力。

answer_page.example_en: We had a lazy day at home on Sunday.
answer_page.example_zh: 周日我们在家悠闲地待了一整天。
answer_page.usage_note: lazy day在此不是贬义，指没有多少安排的休息日。

answer_page.example_en: A cozy night in sounds better than going out.
answer_page.example_zh: 比起出门，在家舒舒服服过一晚更好。
answer_page.usage_note: night in指在家度过的晚上。

answer_page.example_en: This sofa offers much more comfort than the old one.
answer_page.example_zh: 这张沙发比旧沙发舒服多了。
answer_page.usage_note: comfort是名词，表示舒适感。

answer_page.example_en: I like reading in the armchair by the window.
answer_page.example_zh: 我喜欢坐在窗边的扶手椅读书。
answer_page.usage_note: armchair是带扶手的单人椅。

answer_page.example_en: My father likes to nap in his recliner.
answer_page.example_zh: 父亲喜欢在躺椅上打盹。
answer_page.usage_note: recliner是靠背或脚托可以调节的椅子。

answer_page.example_en: I sank into the beanbag with a good book.
answer_page.example_zh: 我拿着一本好书窝进豆袋椅里。
answer_page.usage_note: beanbag指里面填充颗粒的软座椅。

answer_page.example_en: Put your feet on the ottoman while you relax.
answer_page.example_zh: 放松时把脚搭在脚凳上。
collocations: rest your feet on an ottoman
answer_page.usage_note: ottoman在家具语境常指软垫脚凳。

answer_page.example_en: Adjust the footrest so your legs feel comfortable.
answer_page.example_zh: 调整脚踏，让双腿舒服些。
answer_page.usage_note: footrest是支撑双脚的部件或家具。

answer_page.example_en: I put a cushion behind my back on the sofa.
answer_page.example_zh: 我在沙发上往背后垫了个靠垫。
answer_page.usage_note: cushion是软垫，也可指座垫。

answer_page.example_en: The throw pillow makes the couch look more inviting.
answer_page.example_zh: 装饰抱枕让沙发看起来更舒适。
answer_page.usage_note: throw pillow主要指沙发等处的装饰抱枕。

answer_page.example_en: Could you bring me a blanket? I'm a little cold.
answer_page.example_zh: 能给我拿条毯子吗？我有点冷。
answer_page.usage_note: blanket是可用来盖住身体保暖的毯子。

answer_page.example_en: She draped a throw blanket over the back of the sofa.
answer_page.example_zh: 她把沙发盖毯搭在沙发靠背上。
answer_page.usage_note: throw blanket通常比床上被子小，可装饰或保暖。

answer_page.example_en: I pulled the duvet over me and went back to sleep.
answer_page.example_zh: 我拉过被子盖好，又睡着了。
answer_page.usage_note: duvet是填充式被子，常配被套。

answer_page.example_en: This pillow is too firm for my neck.
answer_page.example_zh: 这只枕头对我的脖子来说太硬了。
answer_page.usage_note: pillow是睡觉时枕头部的枕头。

answer_page.example_en: I changed into my pajamas as soon as I got home.
answer_page.example_zh: 我一到家就换上睡衣。
answer_page.usage_note: pajamas美式常用复数，英式也写pyjamas。

answer_page.example_en: I wear sweatpants when I relax at home.
answer_page.example_zh: 我在家放松时穿休闲运动裤。
answer_page.usage_note: sweatpants通常是宽松的休闲裤，美式常用。

answer_page.example_en: He pulled on a hoodie before sitting on the balcony.
answer_page.example_zh: 坐到阳台上前，他套上一件连帽卫衣。
answer_page.usage_note: hoodie指带兜帽的休闲上衣。

answer_page.example_en: Leave your slippers by the couch when you sit down.
answer_page.example_zh: 坐下时把拖鞋放在沙发旁。
answer_page.usage_note: slippers通常用复数指室内拖鞋。

answer_page.example_en: I made a big mug of tea for the evening.
answer_page.example_zh: 我晚上泡了一大马克杯茶。
answer_page.usage_note: mug通常是带柄且容量较大的杯子。

answer_page.example_en: A cup of tea helps me slow down after work.
answer_page.example_zh: 下班后喝杯茶能让我放慢节奏。
answer_page.usage_note: a cup of tea既可按字面指一杯茶，另有习语义。

answer_page.example_en: Let's make hot chocolate on this chilly evening.
answer_page.example_zh: 天气有点冷，今晚我们做热巧克力喝吧。
answer_page.usage_note: hot chocolate通常指热巧克力饮品。

answer_page.example_en: I grabbed a snack while watching the movie.
answer_page.example_zh: 看电影时我拿了点零食。
answer_page.usage_note: snack指正餐之间吃的少量食物。

answer_page.example_en: I left my book beside the bed.
answer_page.example_zh: 我把书放在床边。
answer_page.usage_note: book在这里是实体或电子书作品。

answer_page.example_en: She's reading a novel on the sofa.
answer_page.example_zh: 她正坐在沙发上读小说。
answer_page.usage_note: novel指长篇虚构叙事作品。

answer_page.example_en: I like reading a magazine on Sunday mornings.
answer_page.example_zh: 周日早晨我喜欢读杂志。
answer_page.usage_note: magazine是定期出版的杂志。

answer_page.example_en: I put on my headphones so I wouldn't disturb anyone.
answer_page.example_zh: 我戴上耳机，以免打扰别人。
answer_page.usage_note: headphones通常用复数，指戴在头上的耳机。

answer_page.example_en: These earbuds fit comfortably in my ears.
answer_page.example_zh: 这些入耳式耳机戴起来很舒服。
answer_page.usage_note: earbuds是放入耳内或耳口的小耳机，常用复数。

answer_page.example_en: Could you turn down the speaker a little?
answer_page.example_zh: 你能把音箱声音调小一点吗？
answer_page.usage_note: speaker在此是扬声器或音箱，不是演讲者。

answer_page.example_en: Where did you put the remote control for the TV?
answer_page.example_zh: 你把电视遥控器放哪儿了？
answer_page.usage_note: remote control表示遥控器，也可表示遥控操作。

answer_page.example_en: We moved the television away from the window.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们把电视机移到了远离窗户的地方。
answer_page.usage_note: television可指电视机或电视节目，视语境而定。

answer_page.example_en: Turn on the lamp next to the sofa, please.
answer_page.example_zh: 请把沙发旁的台灯打开。
answer_page.usage_note: lamp是独立灯具，不一定专指台灯。

answer_page.example_en: This reading light is bright enough for my book.
answer_page.example_zh: 这盏阅读灯足够亮，适合看书。
answer_page.usage_note: reading light用于读书照明。

answer_page.example_en: Close the curtains if the afternoon sun is too bright.
answer_page.example_zh: 如果下午阳光太刺眼，就把窗帘拉上。
answer_page.usage_note: curtains常用复数，指布质窗帘。

answer_page.example_en: Lower the blinds to block the glare.
answer_page.example_zh: 放下百叶帘遮挡刺眼的光。
answer_page.usage_note: blinds通常指可调节叶片的百叶帘。

answer_page.example_en: Turn on the fan if the room feels stuffy.
answer_page.example_zh: 房间闷的话就打开电风扇。
answer_page.usage_note: fan在此指电风扇。

answer_page.example_en: The air conditioner keeps the living room cool.
answer_page.example_zh: 空调让客厅保持凉爽。
answer_page.usage_note: air conditioner是空调设备，口语也常说AC。

answer_page.example_en: Please move the heater away from the curtains.
answer_page.example_zh: 请把取暖器移到远离窗帘的地方。
answer_page.usage_note: heater是取暖器，使用时需保持安全距离。

answer_page.example_en: Set the thermostat a little lower before bed.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡前把温控器设定温度调低一点。
answer_page.usage_note: thermostat用于控制室内温度。

answer_page.example_en: The humidifier helps keep the room from feeling too dry.
answer_page.example_zh: 加湿器有助于让房间不那么干燥。
answer_page.usage_note: humidifier是加湿器，应按说明保持清洁。

answer_page.example_en: I put a small houseplant by the window.
answer_page.example_zh: 我在窗边放了一盆小绿植。
answer_page.usage_note: houseplant指室内养护的植物。

answer_page.example_en: The living room is where we unwind in the evenings.
answer_page.example_zh: 客厅是我们晚上放松的地方。
answer_page.usage_note: living room是家中起居和待客的空间。

answer_page.example_en: I went to my bedroom for some peace and quiet.
answer_page.example_zh: 我回卧室寻求片刻清静。
answer_page.usage_note: bedroom指卧室。

answer_page.example_en: We sat on the balcony and watched the sunset.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们坐在阳台上看日落。
answer_page.usage_note: balcony是建筑物外侧的阳台。

answer_page.example_en: Come and sit down; you look tired.
answer_page.example_zh: 快坐下，你看起来累了。
answer_page.usage_note: sit down是从站立等姿势变为坐姿。

answer_page.example_en: Sit back and relax for a few minutes.
answer_page.example_zh: 往后靠一靠，放松几分钟。
answer_page.usage_note: sit back常表示靠着坐并放松。

answer_page.example_en: I like to lie on the sofa after lunch.
answer_page.example_zh: 午饭后我喜欢躺在沙发上。
answer_page.usage_note: lie作躺下讲，过去式是lay。

answer_page.example_en: The cat curled up beside me on the couch.
answer_page.example_zh: 猫蜷缩在沙发上，靠着我。
answer_page.usage_note: curl up表示把身体蜷成一团。

answer_page.example_en: We snuggled up under a blanket to watch a film.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们依偎在毯子下面看电影。
answer_page.usage_note: snuggle up通常指舒服地紧挨或依偎。

answer_page.example_en: I stood up to stretch my legs after sitting for hours.
answer_page.example_zh: 坐了几小时后，我起身伸伸腿。
answer_page.usage_note: stretch your legs可指伸展腿部或起来走动。

answer_page.example_en: After finishing the chores, I just wanted to kick back.
answer_page.example_zh: 做完家务，我只想悠闲地休息。
answer_page.usage_note: kick back是非正式口语，表示放松。

answer_page.example_en: I'm going to take a nap before dinner.
answer_page.example_zh: 晚饭前我打算小睡一会儿。
answer_page.usage_note: take a nap指短暂睡眠，不一定限定午后。

answer_page.example_en: Close your eyes for a moment and relax.
answer_page.example_zh: 闭上眼睛休息片刻吧。
answer_page.usage_note: close your eyes意为闭眼，不必然表示入睡。

answer_page.example_en: I flipped through a magazine while waiting for tea.
answer_page.example_zh: 等茶泡好时，我随手翻了翻杂志。
answer_page.usage_note: flip through表示快速随意翻阅。

answer_page.example_en: Let's put on some music while we cook dinner.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们做晚饭时放点音乐吧。
answer_page.usage_note: put on music在此指开始播放音乐。

answer_page.example_en: We watched a show together before bed.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡前我们一起看了个节目。
answer_page.usage_note: show在此指电视或流媒体节目。

answer_page.example_en: Turn on the TV; the documentary is about to start.
answer_page.example_zh: 打开电视，纪录片快开始了。
answer_page.usage_note: turn on用于打开电器。

answer_page.example_en: Please turn the TV off before you go to bed.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡觉前请把电视关掉。
answer_page.usage_note: turn off指关闭设备，宾语为代词时置于中间。

answer_page.example_en: I sometimes scroll on my phone while resting on the couch.
answer_page.example_zh: 休息时我有时会躺在沙发上刷手机。
collocations: scroll through posts on your phone
answer_page.usage_note: scroll在手机语境指滑动屏幕浏览内容。

answer_page.example_en: I like to browse the internet for new recipes.
answer_page.example_zh: 我喜欢上网浏览新食谱。
answer_page.usage_note: browse表示随意浏览网页，而非有明确目标地查找。

answer_page.example_en: I'll make a cup of tea before we sit down.
answer_page.example_zh: 坐下休息前我先泡杯茶。
collocations: make someone a cup of tea
answer_page.usage_note: make tea在此指泡茶。

answer_page.example_en: Let's grab a snack before the movie starts.
answer_page.example_zh: 电影开始前我们拿点零食吧。
answer_page.usage_note: grab在此口语化表示随手拿或吃一点。

answer_page.example_en: We decided to order takeout and stay home.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们决定点外卖，待在家里。
answer_page.usage_note: takeout偏美式；英式可用takeaway。

answer_page.example_en: I'd like to light a candle for a cozy evening.
answer_page.example_zh: 我想点一支蜡烛，让晚上更温馨。
answer_page.usage_note: light作动词指点燃，蜡烛须远离可燃物。

answer_page.example_en: Dim the lights so we can watch the film comfortably.
answer_page.example_zh: 把灯光调暗些，方便我们舒服地看电影。
answer_page.usage_note: dim作动词指降低灯光亮度。

answer_page.example_en: Draw the curtains to keep out the afternoon sun.
answer_page.example_zh: 拉上窗帘挡住下午的阳光。
answer_page.usage_note: draw the curtains常表示拉上窗帘，具体方向由语境决定。

answer_page.example_en: Open the window for a few minutes before bedtime.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡前开窗几分钟吧。
answer_page.usage_note: open the window指把窗户打开。

answer_page.example_en: Let's let in fresh air while the weather is nice.
answer_page.example_zh: 天气不错，让新鲜空气进来吧。
collocations: open windows to let in fresh air
answer_page.usage_note: let in表示让外面的东西进入。

answer_page.example_en: Turn on the fan if you're feeling warm.
answer_page.example_zh: 如果觉得热，就打开风扇。
answer_page.usage_note: fan在此指电风扇。

answer_page.example_en: Adjust the thermostat to make the room more comfortable.
answer_page.example_zh: 调一下温控器，让房间更舒适。
answer_page.usage_note: thermostat用于设置和控制温度。

answer_page.example_en: Wrap yourself in a blanket and get comfortable.
answer_page.example_zh: 用毯子裹住自己，舒服地坐着吧。
collocations: wrap up in a warm blanket
answer_page.usage_note: wrap yourself in强调把毯子围裹在身上。

answer_page.example_en: I change into comfy clothes as soon as I get home.
answer_page.example_zh: 我一到家就换上舒服的衣服。
answer_page.usage_note: comfy为comfortable的口语说法。

answer_page.example_en: Take off your shoes and make yourself at home.
answer_page.example_zh: 脱下鞋，别拘束，就像在自己家一样。
answer_page.usage_note: take off可表示脱掉衣物或鞋。

answer_page.example_en: I'm going to have a long bath to relax tonight.
answer_page.example_zh: 今晚我要舒舒服服泡个澡放松一下。
answer_page.usage_note: have a bath是常见英式表达，美式多说take a bath。

answer_page.example_en: I do some gentle stretching after sitting at my desk all day.
answer_page.example_zh: 在书桌前坐了一整天后，我做些轻柔拉伸。
answer_page.usage_note: gentle stretching强调动作柔和。

answer_page.example_en: Practice deep breathing for a few minutes before sleep.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡前练几分钟深呼吸。
answer_page.usage_note: deep breathing指有意识地缓慢深呼吸。

answer_page.example_en: I meditate for ten minutes after work.
answer_page.example_zh: 下班后我冥想十分钟。
answer_page.usage_note: meditate指进行冥想或专注练习。

answer_page.example_en: Put your phone away so you can enjoy the evening.
answer_page.example_zh: 把手机放一边，好好享受晚上吧。
collocations: put your phone away for a while
answer_page.usage_note: put away在此指暂时收起手机。

answer_page.example_en: Switch off notifications while you're resting.
answer_page.example_zh: 休息时把通知关掉吧。
answer_page.usage_note: switch off与turn off在这里都指关闭通知功能。

question_page.cue_zh: 安顿下来准备舒服待着

answer_page.meaning_zh: 安顿下来准备舒服待着
answer_page.example_en: Once the guests left, we settled in for a quiet evening.
answer_page.example_zh: 客人走后，我们安顿下来，准备安静地过一晚。
answer_page.usage_note: settle in指安顿好并进入舒适状态。

answer_page.example_en: I sometimes zone out while listening to soft music.
answer_page.example_zh: 听轻音乐时我有时会放空发呆。
answer_page.usage_note: zone out是非正式说法，指短暂走神或放空。

answer_page.example_en: I caught myself daydreaming by the window.
answer_page.example_zh: 我发现自己在窗边做白日梦。
answer_page.usage_note: daydream指清醒时出神想象。

answer_page.example_en: Take a moment to yourself after such a busy day.
answer_page.example_zh: 忙了一整天，给自己一点独处时间吧。
answer_page.usage_note: 表示短暂留给自己安静放松的时间。

answer_page.example_en: We plan to have a quiet evening at home tonight.
answer_page.example_zh: 今晚我们打算在家安静地过一晚。
answer_page.usage_note: quiet evening指活动少、气氛安静的晚上。

answer_page.example_en: I'm going to bed early because I'm exhausted.
answer_page.example_zh: 我累坏了，今晚要早点睡。
collocations: try to go to bed early
answer_page.usage_note: go to bed强调上床准备睡觉。

answer_page.example_en: I felt relaxed after spending an afternoon reading.
answer_page.example_zh: 读了一下午书后，我感到很放松。
answer_page.usage_note: relaxed形容人的放松状态，区别于relaxing令人放松的。

answer_page.example_en: These sweatpants are really comfy.
answer_page.example_zh: 这条运动裤穿起来真舒服。
answer_page.usage_note: comfy是comfortable的非正式用法。

answer_page.example_en: The house feels peaceful on Sunday mornings.
answer_page.example_zh: 周日早晨家里显得很宁静。
answer_page.usage_note: peaceful强调宁静且少受干扰。

answer_page.example_en: I felt calm after a few minutes of breathing exercises.
answer_page.example_zh: 做了几分钟呼吸练习后，我平静下来。
answer_page.usage_note: calm在此形容情绪平静。

answer_page.example_en: A restful weekend was exactly what I needed.
answer_page.example_zh: 我正需要一个能好好休息的周末。
answer_page.usage_note: restful表示有助于恢复精力的。

answer_page.example_en: I finally felt rested after sleeping in.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡了个懒觉后，我终于觉得休息好了。
answer_page.usage_note: rested形容已得到充分休息的状态。

answer_page.example_en: A short walk left me feeling refreshed.
answer_page.example_zh: 散了一小会儿步，我感觉精神焕发。
answer_page.usage_note: refreshed指恢复精神、感觉清爽。

answer_page.example_en: I felt recharged after a weekend away from work.
answer_page.example_zh: 周末不工作好好休息后，我又充满了精力。
answer_page.usage_note: recharged比喻恢复了精神与体力。

answer_page.example_en: I'm getting sleepy, so I'll turn the TV off.
answer_page.example_zh: 我开始犯困了，要把电视关掉。
answer_page.usage_note: sleepy表示想睡觉。

answer_page.example_en: The warm room made me feel drowsy.
answer_page.example_zh: 温暖的房间让我昏昏欲睡。
answer_page.usage_note: drowsy比sleepy更突出昏沉欲睡。

answer_page.example_en: I'm too tired to cook tonight.
answer_page.example_zh: 我今晚累得不想做饭。
answer_page.usage_note: tired通常指疲劳，不一定马上想睡。

answer_page.example_en: I'm completely worn out after moving furniture.
answer_page.example_zh: 搬完家具后，我累坏了。
answer_page.usage_note: worn out口语中表示非常疲惫。

answer_page.example_en: She was exhausted after the long drive.
answer_page.example_zh: 长途开车后，她精疲力尽。
answer_page.usage_note: exhausted比tired程度更强。

answer_page.example_en: I feel drained after a day of back-to-back meetings.
answer_page.example_zh: 连续开了一天会，我感觉精力耗尽。
answer_page.usage_note: drained强调精神或体力被消耗殆尽。

answer_page.example_en: I've been stressed all week and need a break.
answer_page.example_zh: 我这一周压力都很大，需要休息。
answer_page.usage_note: stressed表示感到压力。

answer_page.example_en: I felt overwhelmed by everything I had to do.
answer_page.example_zh: 要做的事情太多，我感到不堪重负。
answer_page.usage_note: overwhelmed强调事情多到难以应付。

answer_page.example_en: My shoulders feel tense after working at the computer.
answer_page.example_zh: 用电脑工作后，我的肩膀紧绷绷的。
answer_page.usage_note: tense在此指身体或情绪紧绷。

answer_page.example_en: I felt anxious before the meeting, so I sat quietly for a while.
answer_page.example_zh: 开会前我有些焦虑，于是安静地坐了一会儿。
answer_page.usage_note: anxious表示焦虑担心，程度因语境而异。

answer_page.example_en: The kids were bored on a rainy afternoon indoors.
answer_page.example_zh: 下雨的下午，孩子们待在家里觉得无聊。
answer_page.usage_note: bored指人觉得无聊，boring指令人无聊。

answer_page.example_en: I felt content just sitting by the window with tea.
answer_page.example_zh: 我只是坐在窗边喝茶，就感到心满意足。
answer_page.usage_note: content作形容词表示满足，重音通常在第二音节。

answer_page.example_en: I feel at ease when I'm at home.
answer_page.example_zh: 在家里我感到很自在。
answer_page.usage_note: at ease表示自在、不紧张。

answer_page.example_en: He has a laid-back attitude to weekends.
answer_page.example_zh: 他对周末安排很随性。
answer_page.usage_note: laid-back形容轻松随和。

answer_page.example_en: We had a lazy Sunday at home.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们在家过了个懒洋洋的周日。
answer_page.usage_note: lazy可指不想活动，不一定带贬义。

answer_page.example_en: The little reading nook feels snug.
answer_page.example_zh: 小小的阅读角暖和舒适。
answer_page.usage_note: snug强调暖和、舒适。

answer_page.example_en: This blanket will keep you warm.
answer_page.example_zh: 这条毯子能让你保持暖和。
answer_page.usage_note: warm指暖和。

answer_page.example_en: The bedroom stays cool in the evening.
answer_page.example_zh: 卧室晚上保持凉爽。
answer_page.usage_note: cool在此表示凉爽。

answer_page.example_en: It's too hot in here; open a window.
answer_page.example_zh: 屋里太热了，开扇窗吧。
answer_page.usage_note: too hot指热得不舒服。

answer_page.example_en: It's too cold to sit outside tonight.
answer_page.example_zh: 今晚太冷，不能在外面坐着。
answer_page.usage_note: too cold指冷得过头。

answer_page.example_en: The neighbors were noisy all evening.
answer_page.example_zh: 邻居整晚都很吵。
answer_page.usage_note: noisy表示噪声大。

answer_page.example_en: I felt well-rested after sleeping in.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡了个懒觉后我休息得很充分。
answer_page.usage_note: well-rested指休息充分。

answer_page.example_en: We enjoyed an unhurried morning.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们度过了一个从容的早晨。
answer_page.usage_note: unhurried是不慌不忙的。

answer_page.example_en: The gentle music was soothing.
answer_page.example_zh: 轻柔的音乐让人放松。
answer_page.usage_note: soothing描述令人平静放松的事物。

answer_page.example_en: I hope you have a stress-free weekend.
answer_page.example_zh: 祝你周末没有压力。
answer_page.usage_note: stress-free强调少有压力。

answer_page.example_en: I need a distraction-free place to read.
answer_page.example_zh: 我需要一处不受干扰的阅读空间。
answer_page.usage_note: distraction-free表示没有使人分心的干扰。

answer_page.example_en: I can't relax with the TV so loud.
answer_page.example_zh: 电视声音这么大，我放松不下来。
answer_page.usage_note: can't后面用动词原形。

answer_page.example_en: I've been having trouble sleeping lately.
answer_page.example_zh: 我最近睡眠有困难。
answer_page.usage_note: have trouble doing表示做某事有困难。

answer_page.example_en: I felt restless and couldn't sit still.
answer_page.example_zh: 我坐立不安，静不下来。
answer_page.usage_note: restless表示难以安静休息。

answer_page.example_en: I noticed some restlessness before bedtime.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡前我察觉自己有些坐立不安。
answer_page.usage_note: restlessness是名词。

answer_page.example_en: Soft music makes pleasant background noise.
answer_page.example_zh: 轻音乐是令人愉快的背景声。
answer_page.usage_note: background noise指环境背景声音。

answer_page.example_en: Our loud neighbors made sleep difficult.
answer_page.example_zh: 吵闹的邻居让人难以入睡。
answer_page.usage_note: loud形容声音大。

answer_page.example_en: The bright light kept me awake.
answer_page.example_zh: 刺眼的灯光让我睡不着。
answer_page.usage_note: bright在此指强光。

answer_page.example_en: An uncomfortable temperature can interrupt sleep.
answer_page.example_zh: 不舒服的温度可能影响睡眠。
answer_page.usage_note: temperature表示温度。

answer_page.example_en: We opened the window to air out the stuffy room.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们打开窗户给闷热的房间通风。
answer_page.usage_note: stuffy强调闷且不通风。

answer_page.example_en: There's a cold draft under the door.
answer_page.example_zh: 门下面有一股冷风。
answer_page.usage_note: draft在美式可指穿堂风。

answer_page.example_en: The dry air makes my throat uncomfortable.
answer_page.example_zh: 干燥的空气让我的喉咙不舒服。
answer_page.usage_note: dry air指湿度偏低的空气。

answer_page.example_en: Too much screen time makes it harder to unwind.
answer_page.example_zh: 屏幕看太久让我难以放松。
answer_page.usage_note: screen time指使用电子屏幕的时间。

answer_page.example_en: I get eye strain from staring at a screen.
answer_page.example_zh: 长时间盯屏幕让我眼疲劳。
answer_page.usage_note: eye strain指眼疲劳。

answer_page.example_en: I have some neck stiffness from sitting all day.
answer_page.example_zh: 久坐让我颈部有些僵硬。
answer_page.usage_note: stiffness是僵硬感。

answer_page.example_en: I developed a backache after the long drive.
answer_page.example_zh: 长途开车后我背疼。
answer_page.usage_note: backache指背痛。

answer_page.example_en: I have a headache and need some quiet.
answer_page.example_zh: 我头疼，需要安静一会儿。
answer_page.usage_note: headache是头痛。

answer_page.example_en: Mental fatigue makes it hard to concentrate.
answer_page.example_zh: 精神疲劳让人难以集中注意力。
answer_page.usage_note: mental fatigue指精神或认知疲劳。

answer_page.example_en: I try not to bring work stress home.
answer_page.example_zh: 我尽量不把工作压力带回家。
answer_page.usage_note: work stress是工作相关压力。

answer_page.example_en: Frequent interruptions make it hard to rest.
answer_page.example_zh: 不断的打扰让人很难休息。
answer_page.usage_note: interruptions是多次打断。

answer_page.example_en: Turn off notifications during your break.
answer_page.example_zh: 休息时关掉消息通知。
answer_page.usage_note: turn off用于关闭通知功能。

answer_page.example_en: Put your phone on silent while you rest.
answer_page.example_zh: 休息时把手机设成静音。
answer_page.usage_note: on silent表示静音模式。

answer_page.example_en: I use noise-canceling headphones on noisy days.
answer_page.example_zh: 环境吵时我戴降噪耳机。
answer_page.usage_note: noise-canceling指降噪功能。

answer_page.example_en: Lower the volume so everyone can relax.
answer_page.example_zh: 把音量调低，让大家放松。
answer_page.usage_note: lower在此指调低。

answer_page.example_en: Close the blinds to block the glare.
answer_page.example_zh: 拉上百叶帘挡住刺眼的光。
answer_page.usage_note: blinds通常用复数。

answer_page.example_en: Adjust the room temperature before bed.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡前调整一下室温。
answer_page.usage_note: room temperature指室内温度。

answer_page.example_en: Let's go outside and get some fresh air.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们出去透透气吧。
answer_page.usage_note: get some fresh air表示透气。

answer_page.example_en: Change positions if you've been sitting too long.
answer_page.example_zh: 坐太久了就换个姿势。
answer_page.usage_note: change positions指改变身体姿势。

answer_page.example_en: Stand up and stretch your back gently.
answer_page.example_zh: 站起来轻轻伸展背部。
answer_page.usage_note: stretch指伸展。

answer_page.example_en: Let's take a short walk around the block.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们绕街区走一小圈。
answer_page.usage_note: take a walk是散步的固定搭配。

answer_page.example_en: Drink some water before sitting down again.
answer_page.example_zh: 重新坐下前喝点水。
answer_page.usage_note: some表示不限定具体水量。

answer_page.example_en: It's important to set boundaries around work calls.
answer_page.example_zh: 对工作电话设定界限很重要。
answer_page.usage_note: set boundaries表示划定个人界限。

answer_page.example_en: I asked for some quiet so I could read.
answer_page.example_zh: 我请大家安静一点，好让我读书。
answer_page.usage_note: ask for是请求的常用搭配。

answer_page.example_en: Make time to rest even when you're busy.
answer_page.example_zh: 即使忙，也要安排休息时间。
answer_page.usage_note: make time to表示有意识地腾出时间。

answer_page.example_en: I try to avoid staying up late on weekdays.
answer_page.example_zh: 我尽量避免工作日熬夜。
answer_page.usage_note: avoid之后接动名词。

answer_page.example_en: I try to get enough sleep each night.
answer_page.example_zh: 我尽量每天晚上睡够觉。
answer_page.usage_note: get enough sleep指睡眠充足。

answer_page.example_en: Stick to a bedtime that works for you.
answer_page.example_zh: 坚持适合自己的固定就寝时间。
answer_page.usage_note: stick to指坚持遵守安排。

answer_page.example_en: Take a proper rest before you start again.
answer_page.example_zh: 重新开始前好好休息一会儿。
answer_page.usage_note: proper强调充分而不是敷衍。
